channel.title: Servers Australia incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Servers Australia's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Service Disruption to Rack 0402 in Equinix SY4 [resolved]
item.description: The failed server's PSU has been replaced, and returned to service. All affected services in Rack 0402 have been restored.

item.title: Further Configuration Issues with Sydney Firewall Cluster [resolved]
Configuration Issues with Sydney Firewall Cluster [resolved]
Sydney-Brisbane Intercapital backhaul service interruption [resolved]
item.description: Engineers have monitored the status of the link overnight and are satisfied that the connection remains stable. This incident is now resolved.

item.title: Equinix BR1 - Colocation rack switch issue [resolved]
item.description: After monitoring overnight, we are satisfied that the issue with this device has been resolved.

item.title: Packet Loss Affecting Some International Connectivity [resolved]
Packet Loss Affecting Some International Connectivity [resolved]
Loss of Power - Rack F13 - SYD2 Colocation [resolved]
Power issue, site on generator - Equinix SY1 [resolved]
item.description:
The Equinix SY1 site team have provided an update to confirm that the site is once again running on utility supply. All services remain operational.
If you have any questions please raise a case via the MySAU portal.

item.title: Loss of Networking - BR1:Rack 0508 [resolved]
item.description:
Our Network Engineers have continued to monitor the affected switch throughout the day, with no further issues reported.
Network services remain stable, and the incident is confirmed as resolved.

item.title: Servers Australia Portal Connectivity Issues [resolved]
item.description:
Engineers have since resolved the issues relating to MySAU Portal connectivity, customers will be able to access their accounts and Support ticketing systems as normal.
Customers who are still experiencing issues relating to this may need to clear their browser cache / use a Private Browsing session or alternative device, otherwise feel free to contact our Support team for assistance.

item.title: Edge firewall issue [resolved]
item.description: There have been no further disruptions, and this incident has been resolved.

item.title: Process Crash on Sydney Routers [resolved]
item.description: We believe this to have been the result of a software bug and as such will be scheduling firmware updates in the new year post embargo for these devices.

item.title: Equinix PE2 - Reduced transit redundancy [resolved]
item.description:
Whilst replacing the optic the technician inadvertently caused an interruption to traffic for services within Equinix PE2. We have resolved the connectivity issue and postponed additional works regarding this module replacement.
The approximate window was between 05:39:05 and 05:46:00 UTC +0.
If you experienced any issues during this period or have any questions, please get in contact with our Support team.

item.title: VCD login page unavailable [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting the VCD login page has been resolved and access has been fully restored.
All services have remained stable during the monitoring period, and the platform is now operating normally.
VMs running on the platform were online and unaffected throughout the incident.

item.title: Virtual Data Center - Loss of connectivity [resolved]
item.description: All connectivity issues have since been resolved earlier Wednesday afternoon, customers are advised to reach out to our Support team if they are still experiencing problems

item.title: MySAU.com.au is currently unavailable [resolved]
item.description:
Our engineering team has implemented a fix, and the service has been fully restored.
We have completed monitoring and can confirm the issue is now resolved.
Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Equinix SY4 Rack 0107 Connectivity Issues [resolved]
item.description:
Power has been restored to Equinix SY4 - Rack 0107, and servers are back online.
If you are experiencing any issues with your server and it is based in Rack 010,7 please raise a support case so our team can assist.

item.title: NetApp Storage Unavailable [resolved]
item.description: After working with the Vendor, this is now confirmed as resolved.
